name: audio-sonic-gpt
description: Analyze attached music locally with Audio Sonic MCP: tempo, key and key map, vibe tags, vocal presence and production features without an external model API.

interface.longDescription: Attach an MP3/WAV/FLAC/M4A/OGG/AAC in ChatGPT and analyze musical features locally through the vendored Audio Sonic MCP pipeline. It returns tempo, key/key-map, vibe tags when CLAP is installed, and production-profile measurements. No external music-model API is required.
defaultPrompt: Analyze the music file I attached and explain its tempo, key, mood and production profile.
Analyze 42 to 58 seconds of my attached track and tell me what changes musically.
